enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Snore. Wake briefly. Turn over. Continue sleeping.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up soap. Lather hands. Wash face. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating breakfast and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Clear table. Wash dishes. Pick up work bag. Exit kitchen.

Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Open door. Walk out. Close door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Scan card. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Swipe badge. Enter locker room. Change into scrubs. Wash hands. Check patient list. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Take vital signs. Record data. Administer medication. Consult with doctor. Update patient charts. Attend meeting. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Respond to nurse call. Assist patient. Clean equipment. End shift.

Leave workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Scan card. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk home. Open door. Enter home. Close door. Remove shoes. Put down bag. Wash hands. Enter kitchen.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Turn off stove. Serve food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Clear table. Wash dishes.

Enter living room. Turn on light. Pick up remote. Press power button. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Browse channels. Select program. Put down remote. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Pick up remote. Change channel. Put down remote. Continue watching. Turn off TV. Turn off light.

Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Enter password. Open browser. Check email. Reply to email. Open document. Type report. Save document. Close document. Open social media. Browse feed. Like post. Close browser. Shut down laptop. Close laptop.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Scrub hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on clothes. Turn off light.

Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Turn page. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off light. Lie down. Close eyes. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Snore. Wake briefly. Turn over. Continue sleeping.
